lesson: The system is consistently attempting to counter-trend trade against a dominant macro downtrend, resulting in 'liquidity traps' where bullish BOS signals are immediately invalidated. The high-confidence long setups are failing because they ignore the macro EMA alignment, treating local exhaustion as a reversal rather than a pullback.
adjustment: Implement a 'Macro-Filter' rule: prohibit all LONG entries unless the price is trading above the 4H 200 EMA, regardless of lower timeframe BOS or liquidity sweeps.
methodology_flag: Trust lower-timeframe SMC structure less when the macro trend is in a confirmed downtrend.
